section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1971
title: ## ALL INDIA SURVEY During 1971, 1,05,601 deaths were reported in India, which had resulted from accidents of various types. The causes of accidents have been classified into two broad categories viz, (i) Accidents due to Act of God such as lightning, heat strokes, landslides etc. and (ii) Accidents due to other causes such as mishaps in factories, air-crashes, railway accidents etc. The break-up of such accidents in the entire country due to various causes is furnished in Table 1. Unlike in the report of 1970, the deaths due to miscellaneous causes have been presented for 1971 under one head only and not separately under Act of God and other causes. There had been a marked decrease of accidental deaths under miscellaneous causes, the decrease being 64,806 deaths during 1970 to 30,141 deaths during 1971. Drowning has also indicated a significant decrease from 27,915 deaths during TABLE—I
